evidence.name: Screen field: Slide picture
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Slide picture" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Slide picture
sections.description: The image shown on this slide, required on every slide no matter which template you pick. Drag-and-drop or click to upload, and Segmently serves a fast-loading optimized version automatically. Use a high-quality picture that matches the slide's message; how it fills the slide is set in Image styles below, and a slide left without an image shows blank, so set one on every slide before publishing.
